findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: revisia_prisma_flow_diagram, revisia_projects, revisia_projects_act, revisia_question, revisia_question_act, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening, revisia_fulltext_act, revisia_rob_act, revisia_report, revisia_export, revisia_jobs, revisia_approve_stage · Private data: revisia_prisma_flow_diagram, revisia_prisma_checklist, revisia_projects, revisia_question_act, revisia_search, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening, revisia_screening_act, revisia_fulltext, revisia_export, revisia_jobs, revisia_approve_stage · Public sink: revisia_prisma_checklist, revisia_projects_act, revisia_question_act, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening_act, revisia_report_act · Destructive: revisia_question_act, revisia_search, revisia_search_act, revisia_screening_act, revisia_fulltext_act, revisia_extraction_act, revisia_rob_act.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
